description: This Java source file 'SqlJdbcUtil.java' contains utility methods for constructing SQL clauses, handling JDBC data bindings, and managing database-specific query nuances within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for generating FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY clauses, handling view entities, and setting/getting values to/from JDBC ResultSet and PreparedStatement objects.

classes.name: SqlJdbcUtil
classes.description: A utility class for SQL clause construction, JDBC value handling, and database-specific query syntax support within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeFromClause
methods.description: Constructs the FROM clause, including joins for view entities, based on the entity model and datasource join style.

methods.name: makeWhereStringFromFields
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause string from provided fields and values, supporting various operators.

methods.name: makeWhereClause
methods.description: Generates a complete WHERE clause for an entity, combining field-based conditions and view entity conditions.

methods.name: makeViewWhereClause
methods.description: Creates a view-specific WHERE clause considering different join styles like 'ansi' and 'theta'.

methods.name: filterColName
methods.description: Sanitizes column names by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Binds entity field values to a SQL processor for executing parameterized queries.

methods.name: setValuesWhereClause
methods.description: Binds non-null entity field values to SQL parameters for WHERE clause construction.

methods.name: setPkValues
methods.description: Assigns primary key values from an entity to a SQL statement.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a column value from a JDBC ResultSet and assigns it to an entity's field, handling various data types.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a field value into a SQL processor, handling data type conversions and encryption if necessary.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns an integer code representing the Java data type, given its class name.

methods.name: addValueSingle
methods.description: Appends a single SQL parameter placeholder or value to a buffer, and optionally adds to condition parameters list.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value or collection of values to an SQL clause buffer, handling collections appropriately.
